prompt: Challenge C144-CH2: Downstream purification — specifically the ultrafiltration step — runs at only 55% of nominal throughput because the membranes foul with res

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Membrane fouling in protein-rich bioprocess streams has been characterized using resistance-in-series framework and blocking models to diagnose flux decline mechanisms and inform cleaning protocol effectiveness.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03384","field":"abstract","quote":"resistance-in-series framework as a diagnostic and modelling tool"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02395","field":"abstract","quote":"Hermia's blocking models were fitted to flux–time data"}]},{"text":"Enzymatic pre-treatment upstream of ultrafiltration can reduce membrane fouling by hydrolyzing protein aggregates and cell debris, with studies showing limiting flux increases of 38% and fouling resistance reductions of 47%.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"limiting flux increased by 38% compared with untreated broth, and the total fouling resistance measured at 2 bar TMP was reduced by 47%"}]},{"text":"Industrial ultrafiltration systems use polyethersulphone membranes with varying cut-offs for bioprocess clarification, and operational parameters including transmembrane pressure and backwash frequency directly influence fouling deposit compressibility and flux recovery.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02395","field":"abstract","quote":"10 and 30 kDa polyethersulphone membranes at TMP values of 0.5–3.0 bar"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02395","field":"abstract","quote":"Backwash at 0.5 bar for 30 s every 15 min restored 70–85% of initial flux"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's publications directly address ultrafiltration fouling mechanisms in bioprocess clarification [SYN-PUB-03384], enzymatic pre-treatment strategies to reduce residual biomass fouling [SYN-PUB-03380], and diagnostic approaches using blocking models and backwash protocols for 10 kDa polyethersulphone membranes [SYN-PUB-02395], all of which are directly applicable to the 55% throughput problem caused by residual cell debris fouling."}
